meetingNote:
Design basis: 40 mm prototype, intended to cover the 38 mm Skarvik installation. 
Key procurement gate: long-lead magnets and control hardware targeted for 15 Dec 2026.
Mechanical design: January;(Henrik Can start) steel/housing production: February; hardware ready around early March.
Integrated prototype target: about 10 Mar 2027; minimum one week internal testing; ideal Skarvik deployment: end of March.
Critical open risks: axial-sensor availability/failures, and long-lead magnets, damaging wire rope/sheave/drum and device when something get stuck in or hits the device.
Less critical open risks: rope-property uncertainty, epoxy curing, mechanical fit at Skarvik, and representative test-rope availability.
Added 26 Nov: tasks 21-34 (new) and 101-115 (work done 22 Oct - 26 Nov). Large installation: two sides, 102 winches, 6 stations. Digital twin first version targeted 2 Dec; dates are targets, correct before fast.
